title: Pipelines and GitOps applied to the cluster: a look at ArgoCD and Flux

videos.script: Every change in this course so far reached the cluster because somebody typed kubectl apply. That works for one person and one laptop. {{typed}} With a team, the question becomes: what is the cluster supposed to be running, and who decided? {{question}} GitOps answers it with a repository. What is in the main branch is what should run. A program in the cluster compares the two, all the time, and makes the cluster match. {{gitops}} Before installing such a program, you will do its job by hand with git and kubectl, so that what Argo CD and Flux automate is something you have already done. {{plan}}
